title: Wallpapers and Mirage trades
notes: 19 new PC wallpapers in Events → Style, including 5 animated ones (Snowfall, Shooting Stars, Aurora, Rainy Window, Firefly Pond). Sakura has been redrawn with falling petals: if you own it, you have the new one.
Finding a Mirage now paints the island in a desert sunset.
changes: The Impossible now needs a Shiny Void Prismatic with no looks from the Prism Altar. Where it was unlocked without one, it has been taken back (its rewards stay).
The Shiny, Void and Prismatic achievements and Born Lucky now count only the looks a Pokémon was found with, not looks from the Prism Altar. Ranks you already have are kept.
Auto-file: Spectral and Mirage are separate filters now. Rules you already have keep filing exactly as before.
Auto-favourite: Spectral and Mirage are separate ticks now. If the old one was on, both are on.
Mirage Pokémon can now be traded, offered, sent through Wonder Trade, sold at the Night Market and auctioned, just like Spectral (one Mirage listing a day). The Prism Altar still won’t take them.
fixes: Costume Pokémon now have their own “1 of N in the world” count, separate from the same Pokémon without a costume.
Fixed: on some fresh installs the New Game name box ignored typing. An out-of-date download now shows Update required and updates itself.

title: Your picks
notes: Compare two Pokémon side by side: tick two in Select mode and press Compare, or press Compare on a Pokémon’s card and click another. See their stats as they fight, their base stats or their IVs, with the higher one lit.
Two-type filter: light two types in the PC Filters to find Pokémon that have both, like Ghost and Poison. Search understands it too: type "ghost poison". The Pokédex search does as well.
Held items and Mega Stones now have their own filters in the PC, and two new sorts: Held item and Mega Stone.
Send to Altar: send Pokémon from the PC (Select bar or a Pokémon’s card) and they wait at the Prism Altar, ready to feed. Nothing is fed until you do the Final check.
Day Care: every parent shows the island it came from, with a 2× mark when the pair comes from two different islands.
Battle Tower: a Move Relearner room. Teach a squad member a move it could have learned at its level.
Battle Tower: the Scanner, a rare reward between floors. For the rest of the run it shows any Pokémon’s ability, nature, IVs and moves.
Friend battles: a six-Pokémon option, using the ranked team rules at Lv 50. It’s unranked: ratings and ranked rewards never change.
Auctions: you can now pick a 4 hour length (4, 12, 24 or 48 hours).
Patch notes are now translated into every language, from 0.60.0 on.
changes: A new filtered box now goes right after your other filtered boxes instead of at the bottom of the PC.
Support the Game now sits at the top of the first Settings tab. Tallgrass is made by one person, and support keeps the servers up.
fixes: Night Market: Spectral Pokémon can be searched for again now that Spooky season is over.
The Tower’s learn-a-move card no longer stretches the Pokémon’s picture.

title: Halloween is over
notes: The daily Halloween costume outbreak and the costume bounties have ended along with Spooky season. Costume Pokémon you already have keep their costume.
